latest_release.name: Data Formulator 0.8b1
latest_release.body: This beta introduces a more polished and consistent Data Formulator experience, with improved workspace and session management, streamlined data connector workflows, responsive high-resolution layouts, and refined chart themes and controls. It also expands connector and authentication support, improves persistence and desktop packaging, and includes broad reliability, accessibility, and release automation updates. We welcome feedback as we work toward the stable 0.8 release. ## What's Changed * readme by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/355 * test: keep zh locale keys aligned by @cat0825 in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/357 * Mini analyst agent by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/367 * Dev by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/370 * fix(security): systematic Dependabot & code-scanning follow-up by @Chenglong-MS with @Copilot in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/380 * fix(mysql-loader): refresh REPEATABLE READ snapshot before each query by @chanxiusun in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/381 * Release 0.8.0 alpha 2 by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/382 * 0.8a3 by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/399 * Gracefully degrade chart insights for text-only models by @Chenglong-MS with @Copilot in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/400 * Dev by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/403 * Dev by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/404 * Fix broken .gitignore escaping by @iki in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/406 * Add built-in ClickHouse data loader by @ilia-sokolov in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/405 * 0.8 b1 by @Chenglong-MS in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/411 ## New Contributors * @cat0825 made their first contribution in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/357 * @chanxiusun made their first contribution in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/381 * @iki made their first contribution in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/406 * @ilia-sokolov made their first contribution in https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/pull/405 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microsoft/data-formulator/compare/0.7.0...0.8b1
